cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Get into bed, love; I've warmed your side. No forty-minute wait here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up instead of leaving me at that taxi rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could. I'll get another blanket. I remember how cold it was outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you just warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love. Both feet. I wouldn't leave any part of you waiting that long.
